title: Brazil’s Lula to embark on ‘historic’ state visit to Manila
summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will visit Manila for a state visit on Nov. 14-15, 2026, upon the invitation of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., Malacañang announced Tuesday.
